report.summary: Patient P-D009 (age 73, Medicare Advantage Lakeshore Senior PPO, home tract 17031720500) needs help with utilities and transport. For utilities: shutoff prevention walk-in clinic Tuesdays, a pre-application form to check qualification (responds within one business day), and income-based gas/electric bill help in person Mon/Wed. For transport: patient is not Medicaid, so the Medicaid Ride Line is not eligible; ADA paratransit requires certification (up to 21 days); Senior Shuttle West offers free weekday 7 AM–5 PM medical rides for adults 60+ and appears eligible by age.
